correctness.rationale: The closed-neighborhood hitting reduction is exact: the neighborhood constraints test nonemptiness and the pairwise symmetric-difference constraints test all trace inequalities. A fresh independent set-based reproduction constructs adjacency by explicit modular predicates and checks all 63004 subsets of sizes 0–7 by taking the set of the 18 literal traces; there are no codes below seven and 90 at seven, including the stated witness. Equal-size codes are adjacent exactly when they have a common six-element subset, so grouping optima over those subsets independently reconstructs all exchange edges. It gives 81 edges and nine components of each reported degree pattern. In a five-vertex component the universal vertex leaves four vertices of degree one after deletion, hence two disjoint edges and a bowtie; the other two patterns force P3 and K2. Applying all 18 simultaneous rotations/reflections gives the six listed representatives, orbit sizes, degrees and component types and covers all optima. The same actions preserve the host relation (both cycle layers and the matching) and hence identifying traces and exchanges.
residual_risks: The C++ checker does not explicitly check membership of the named witness as the prose suggests; the independent checker does. This is not a gap in the counting proof. No slide or general-cycle claim is verified.
